title: GitLab Product Marketing & Event Planning Meeting
summary: The meeting aligned the GTM team on corporate event support, product announcement cadence, feature prioritization, competitive analysis, and branding. Key outcomes include committing to three announcement items per stage, defining a top‑five feature set for upcoming keynotes, updating the competitive spreadsheet with tier‑one competitors and GitLab, and adopting a green color scheme for the comparison page. The group also approved the tagline "more speed, less risk" and set several follow‑up tasks. Next steps involve finalizing the announcement timeline, completing the listed action items, and sharing the new design‑team infographic.
